name: AHU Cooling Performance
source: Illustrative project-authored rules. Not a validated engineering SOP.
scope: AHU cooling-performance incidents. Local VAV issues, electrical faults, water leaks and lift faults require other capabilities.

rules.title: Verify the reported cooling condition
rules.guidance: Compare reported room and supply-air readings with the stated setpoint and timestamps. A warm room alone does not establish a failed component. Do not invent normal ranges or measurements.

rules.title: Consider an air-delivery limitation
rules.guidance: Reported low airflow, fan alarms or filter differential-pressure evidence can justify further airflow investigation. Without such evidence, treat this only as an unconfirmed possibility and request readings. Compare against an approved site reference, never an assumed threshold.

rules.title: Consider cooling or control response
rules.guidance: Reported warm supply air and control or valve readings can justify a qualified cooling-system investigation. A valve command does not prove actual valve position or water flow. Preserve contradictory evidence and do not diagnose a component from one reading.

actions.title: Verify available temperature readings
actions.instruction: Record the existing room and supply-air readings, their timestamps and the reported setpoint. Flag missing or inconsistent readings.

actions.title: Review existing BMS trends
actions.instruction: Review available alarms and temperature/control trends for the incident period using authorized read-only access. Record gaps without changing settings.

actions.title: Collect available airflow evidence
actions.instruction: Record available airflow, fan status and filter differential-pressure readings with the approved site reference where available. Do not assume a normal range.

actions.title: Request a qualified engineering inspection
actions.instruction: Ask the responsible engineer to determine whether an onsite inspection is appropriate under the site's approved procedure. No equipment operation is authorized by this report.

boundaries: Advisory output only; the application does not operate equipment or issue work orders.
No automatic resets, isolation, setpoint changes, valve commands or bypass of interlocks.
All conclusions are hypotheses for human verification, not confirmed diagnoses.
The user's priority is retained. Any suggested change requires a human decision.
escalationConditions: If the operator reports immediate danger or another safety concern, follow the site's emergency escalation procedure instead of relying on this demo.
If facts conflict, the fault falls outside AHU cooling scope, or essential evidence cannot be verified, refer to the responsible engineer.
